title: Base case k=m: dimension count Hilb(R^{m,l,m-1}) = qbin(m+l,m) - q^m qbin(l,m)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Base case dimension count ($k=m$).**

The induction on $k$ underlying the main identity $(\star)$ needs the base case $Q_{m,\ell,m}(q)=q^m\binom{\ell}{m}_q$. Since $R^{m,\ell,m}=R^{m,\ell}$, this is equivalent to
$$\mathrm{Hilb}(R^{m,\ell,m-1};q)=\binom{m+\ell}{m}_q-q^{m}\binom{\ell}{m}_q,\qquad(\ddagger)$$
i.e. $\dim_\mathbb Q\big(R^{m,\ell}/R^{m,\ell,m-1}\big)_d$ equals the number of partitions of $d$ with **exactly $m$ parts, each $\le \ell-m+1$**.

**To prove (currently only checked symbolically for small parameters):** identity $(\ddagger)$, i.e. a complete graded-dimension description of the proper subalgebra $\mathbb Q\langle e_1,\dots,e_{m-1}\rangle\subseteq R^{m,\ell}$.

**Why it is genuine.** One must determine exactly which degree-$d$ elements of $R^{m,\ell}$ lie in the subalgebra generated by $e_1,\dots,e_{m-1}$ only. This requires (a) a spanning argument and (b) a matching independence/lower-bound argument; the complementary set must be shown to be precisely the partitions with exactly $m$ parts each $\le\ell-m+1$. Counting heuristics alone do not suffice.

**Suggested attack.** Specialize the leading-term basis of suggestion in GAP 1 to $k=m$ (a single combinatorial model, no recursion needed). Equivalently, use box duality $\lambda\mapsto$ complement in $m\times\ell$ to convert $(\ddagger)$ into a "missing-classes" count and identify the missing classes with full-length-$m$ partitions.

**Status.** Critic verified $(\ddagger)$ directly for $1\le m\le3$, $m\le\ell\le4$, via Schur-basis row reduction; the target is correct, only a general proof is missing.
